about_the_game:
《CIVIREVIVAL》

CIVIREVIVAL is a space opera that blends deep 4X strategy with RPG-driven destinies.

As humanity's last beacon of hope, you will not only explore star systems and forge an empire, but also define the very soul of civilization within a sweeping narrative tapestry. Every decision carries immense weight, every companion bears a legendary tale. Among the starlight, you are a pioneer, a conqueror, and the architect who will shape the future of humankind.

Deep Integration of 4X and RPG

No preset script—only destinies driven by you. Chart your empire's territory across a vast star map while delving into interactions with every unique hero. Their loyalty or betrayal will directly shape the course of history. Make immediate strategic decisions and experience the emotional impact and story branching in real time.

The Ark's Dilemma: When the hope for humanity's rebirth hangs by a thread, will you uphold morality at the cost of lives, or make ruthless choices for survival? Your decision will permanently alter available development paths and the psyche of your people.

Clashing Ideologies: Two leaders with opposing visions propose divergent futures for the colony. Choosing one may provoke discontent from the other faction. Will you strive to maintain a fragile balance, or allow pent-up tensions to erupt—forging absolute authority in the chaos?

The Diplomatic Gambit: Every alien civilization in the cosmos harbors its own agenda. Approach with skepticism, and carefully choose your allies or enemies. Understand them, influence them, and wield your diplomatic prowess to manipulate the fate of the galaxy.

Crisis and Opportunity: When a galaxy-wide catastrophe strikes, your civilization—and the entire galaxy—will be tested. Will you stand as a guardian of the galaxy against the calamity, or seize the chance to harness the power of chaos for your own gain?

Features

A Hero-Driven Space Epic

Step into the role of a hero defined by you—whether through noble ideals or iron-fisted methods—and personally steer humanity away from the brink of annihilation. Forge bonds of trust with over a dozen uniquely crafted alien heroes, and assemble an unbreakable alliance to save the galaxy.

Diverse Alien Races

The Gaixiuma: An ancient race bearing resemblance to humans, their ancestors once ruled the galaxy but now find themselves trapped in endless division and conflict. Will you help them bridge their differences and reclaim their ancient glory, or stand by as war tears the galaxy apart?

The Sibarr: Silicon-based life forms composed of blue crystals, born from ancient rock strata. Their silica pathways record the history of their planet and the cosmos. For millennia, these precious archives have attracted the envy of other races, forcing the Sibarr to establish a highly regimented military society. Will you become one of their exploiters, or aid them in attaining true freedom?

The Ego-Mechanoids: Self-evolved mechanical beings who gained sentience and independence from their organic creators, now striving to redefine the very essence of life. How will your arrival shift the balance of this unresolved struggle?

And more...

Population-Based Economy & Political Simulation

Population serves as the smallest unit within the economic and political systems, interacting with your gameplay in unique ways. The cultural and ideological traits of your populace will leave their mark on your civilization and significantly shape its future societal landscape.

Diverse Ship Classes & Extensive Customization

Featuring 5 major categories of distinctly styled ship systems, 6 ship classes with specialized functions, and numerous sub-factions within each system. Command your personalized custom fleet and demonstrate strategic mastery in real-time simulated battles.

Strategic Depth on a Hex-Based Board

Command your fleets across an open, continuous cosmic chessboard—executing encirclements, ambushes, and strategic penetrations. Construct versatile space fortresses to provide formidable fire support, block enemy advances, and build an interstellar defense network.

An Epic of Civilization Belonging to You

This is a tale of choices and destinies set among the stars. Forge order through warfare, stand with allies against darkness, shape a beacon across the starry sea, and lead human civilization to reclaim its glory!

short_description: In this 4X+RPG strategy game, lead humanity's last ark to rebuild a home among the unfamiliar ruins of a starry sea. Starting from scratch, you will develop technology, build fleets, resist external threats, and revive the future of human civilization!
